Switch Installation Connection
Saga Telecom switches support a variety of mounting methods. Network Cable
Please install according to the actual environmental requirements. Use Cat5 and above network cable, shielded type is recommended.
Desktop
Grounding
Wall mounted
Ensure that the grounding screw of the device is effectively grounded
Rack mounted
for safe use.
Install 4 floating screws on the front hole bar of the cabinet, 2 on
Optical Fiber
each side.
Load the device into the cabinet. 1. Optical fibers must be used with the fiber modules.
Use M6 screws to secure the device with the cabinet/rack. 2. Fiber bending radius must not be less than 40mm.
Install earth wire to earth connection point. Power Cord
1. Distance between power cable and network cable should be more
than 10cm.
2. The AC power please use the local standard.
Commercial POE Switch
Safety Precautions
User Manual
Do not look directly at the optical port to prevent the laser beam from
burning your eyes.
Do not install the power cord with power on to avoid personal injury.
(Please do not use until you read this manual)
Do not supply power before device installation and wiring.
Do not install the device in the environment of seepage, drip or
condensation easily, otherwise the equipment might burn out .
Please ensure the environment where the device is installed is well
ventilated, and forbidden to block the cooling holes.
Do not install the device in a high density dust environment.
Do not use aerial cabling outdoor, otherwise the device is prone to
lightning strike.
ESD protection is necessary during installation or maintenance
Grounding and wire routing help limit the effects of noise due to
electromagnetic interference (EMI).
Do not place heavy objects on the device.
Please use this device in the given range of temperature and
humidity.
If rack switches are in a natural heat dissipation environment, please
ensure the separation distance exceeds 1U.
Installation, commissioning and maintenance may only be performed
by qualified electricians.
